name: Aquatic Park
description_short: Protected cove, calm water, popular with swim clubs
body_markdown: Aquatic Park is a protected cove on the northern waterfront, sheltered by a curved municipal pier. Calm conditions year-round make it the go-to open water training ground in the city. The [South End Rowing Club](https://serc.com/) and [Dolphin Club](https://dolphinclub.org/) both occupy clubhouses on the beach and run regular swims.

access.access_summary: The Aquatic Park cove and beach are public and free. The South End and Dolphin clubhouses are separate volunteer clubs; use each club's visitor or membership process for showers, lockers, sauna, and organized club activities.
access_notes: Club access is separate from swimming in the public cove.
If you are new to bay swimming, connect with a club or experienced local swimmer before going alone.

pricing.label: Public cove
pricing.note: No club membership required to swim from the public beach.

pricing.label: South End Rowing Club
pricing.note: Public day-use Tue / Thu / Sat, 09:00-18:00 Jun-Nov and 08:00-17:00 Dec-May.

pricing.label: Dolphin Club
pricing.note: Public day-use Mon / Wed / Fri, with seasonal hours and holiday closures.

clubs.name: South End Rowing Club
clubs.note: Public day-use is available Tuesday, Thursday, and Saturday with seasonal hours. Follow SERC's public day-use requirements before using the clubhouse.

clubs.name: Dolphin Swimming & Boating Club
clubs.note: No public day-use on federal or state holidays. Day-use covers locker rooms, shower, sauna, deck, and lounge; boats are not available to non-members.
